[SWS_DM_02027] Reporting successful writing of data to IdsM
Upstream requirements:

⌈
If a diagnostic service WriteDataByIdentifier is received, which results in a positive re-
sponse, the DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_WRITE_DATA_SUCCESSFUL
to IdsM (see [26] and table [SWS_DM_02028]) with the context data given in
[SWS_DM_02028].
